summary:
Plan to fix the three user-reported issues:
1. Walkthrough spotlight: Cut out the active feature so it remains crystal clear and unblurred while only the rest of the screen gets blurred/dimmed, allowing direct clicking.
2. Support sender name: Replace hardcoded 'Church Submitter' with actual church name and branch/headquarters indicator (e.g., 'GCYC Exusia [HQR]' or 'ICGC Kumasi [BRE]').
3. Resolved tickets & auto-reply: Lock resolved tickets from further replies (view only), and restrict the automated support welcome greeting to the ticket's very first message only.
